title: I THANK YOU JESUS FOR YOUR LOVE TO ME

lines.text: I thank you Jesus for Your love to me,
I thank you Jesus for Your grace so free,
I lift my voice to praise Your Name,
I'll praise you again and again

lyrics:
[Verse]
I thank you Jesus for Your love to me,
I thank you Jesus for Your grace so free,
I lift my voice to praise Your Name,
I'll praise you again and again
You're my everything,
You are my Lord.
